decisions.statement: A deploy is built from the files it is seeded with and every file those reach.
Every kind is seeded with the tracked files under the folder its page sits in.
A web app is seeded as well with the folder its page names as its source.
A web app is seeded as well with its cluster service, its manifest and that manifest's code.
An ios app is seeded as well with the files every ios app build shares.
A workstation service is seeded as well with the code its unit's command runs.
A page a kind's own reader refuses is seeded with the files beside it alone.
A file is reached by asking the graph what that file reaches.
A file reached through another file reached is reached.
A path the imports reach that git does not track is reached by nothing.
A seed is reached whether or not git tracks that seed.
The files are read out of the commit being put up rather than off the worktree.
Which files git tracks is read out of that commit's tree.
The paths a container recipe copies out of its context are seeded here.
Nothing here says what a deploy does with the files it is built from.
One reading of a commit builds every closure asked of it, reading each body once.
Every tracked file in a folder a deploy is built from is carried with that deploy.

definition: the files the artifact a deploy puts up could be built from
